misconception.label: Assumed the line passes through the origin

misconception.remediation_hint: A is at x = 1, not x = 0, so the line has not reached the axis yet.

misconception.label: Read the wrong axis
misconception.remediation_hint: Check whether the question asks for the x-axis or the y-axis.

worked_solution: A is (1, 4) and B is (4, 1), so the line falls 1 for every 1 across. Going on 1 unit from B(4, 1) reaches y = 0 at x = 5. The line cuts the x-axis at (5, 0).

misconception.label: Used run over rise
misconception.remediation_hint: Gradient is the change in y divided by the change in x.

worked_solution: A is (1, 1) and B is (5, 3). Gradient = change in y / change in x = (3 - 1)/(5 - 1) = 2/4. = 1/2.
